# Zakhar Pashkin - AI Product Engineer Portfolio

This site is a personal portfolio for Zakhar Pashkin, an AI product engineer focused on VLM/LLM systems, computer vision, and full-stack delivery across web, mobile, and cloud.

Primary URL: https://zack-dev-cm.github.io/
Contact: mailto:kaisenaiko@gmail.com

## Highlights
- VLM/LLM systems, computer vision, and agentic workflows.
- Full-stack delivery: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Cloud Run, and MLOps.
- Project portfolio with demos, links, and tech stacks.
